ns2:course.label: Modern Dance II
ns2:course.description: Intermediate dance technique and improvisation. For non-dance majors. May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours. Prerequisite: DANC 101 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours. Prerequisite: DANC 101 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Not intended for Dance or Dance major(s).
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Student costs for supplies and concert tickets: Approx. $30. Written assignments and concert attendance is required.
